stories.title: No. 14 Vanderbilt beats Ohio State 72-66 as Tyler Tanner hits go-ahead shot late
stories.summary: Tyler Tanner scored 20 points, including a crucial jumper, as No. 14 Vanderbilt beat Ohio State 72-66.

stories.title: Martha Firestone Ford, Akron native and owner of Detroit Lions, dies at age 101
stories.summary: The Detroit Lions announced the death of the team's owner, Akron native Martha Firestone Ford, on Tuesday evening.

stories.title: Silvia Gonzalez scores 25 as Cleveland State rallies from 22-point deficit to beat Georgia Southern 69-62
stories.summary: Led by Silvia Gonzalez and Macie Taylor, Cleveland State snapped a four-game losing streak by beating Georgia Southern 69-62.

stories.title: Former Ohio State Heisman winner Troy Smith named final 2026 bell ringer in Michigan game
stories.summary: Troy Smith, a Cleveland native who won the Heisman Trophy in 2006 with Ohio State, will ring the Victory Bell prior to the Buckeyes' home clash with Michigan.

stories.title: Study identifies demand for more downtown Cleveland grocery options after Heinen's closure
stories.summary: The analysis found demand for 28,000 more square feet of downtown grocery space, with smaller neighborhood markets seen as the most immediate opportunity.

stories.title: Shaker Heights wants to make misuse of license plate reader data a crime, citing desire for 'transparency and accountability'
stories.summary: Shaker Heights is mulling a first-of-its-kind ordinance in Ohio that would make misuse of Flock Safety's automated license plate data a criminal offense

stories.title: Snowbelt county engineers ask Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine for help after Morton Salt mine closure impacts road salt supply
stories.summary: In a press conference Tuesday, six Northeast Ohio county engineers expressed concerns after a shortfall of road salt supply for this 2026-27 winter season.

stories.title: Cleveland Hopkins, Akron-Canton airports prepare for busy Thanksgiving travel rush: What you need to know
stories.summary: Cleveland Hopkins expects more than 180,000 passengers through Monday as airport officials share holiday travel tips and address concerns about flight disruptions.

stories.title: Cleveland firefighters train to rescue fellow firefighters in mayday scenarios
stories.summary: The training simulates emergency conditions and prepares rapid intervention teams to locate and rescue a downed firefighter.

stories.title: Ben Roethlisberger, Rob Gronkowski are among first-time eligibles advancing in Pro Football Hall of Fame voting process
stories.summary: Ben Roethlisberger and Rob Gronkowski are among the first-time eligible players who have advanced in the voting process for the Pro Football Hall of Fame.

stories.title: Euclid police seek tips on 'person of interest' in murder of 15-year-old boy, burglary
stories.summary: Officers responded to a burglary in progress on East 222nd Street on Saturday and found the 15-year-old victim unresponsive in the hallway.

stories.title: Fire breaks out at unfinished medical building addition in Aurora
stories.summary: A passerby spotted the fire Monday night at a medical building on Walden Place Drive, according to the Aurora Fire Department.
